name: Tiana
source:
A girl living in Cattleya Kingdom. Her dream is to become a beastmaster, just like her mother. She roams around the city, looking for animals to be tamed. By blowing the whistle her father made for her, any animal can be tamed.

[from [url=http://www.otomate.jp/beast/flower_snow/chara/]Official site[/url]]
